unit_rule: The same five frozen JOSS publication concepts only. No replacement publication, archive version, repository, release, tag, commit, provider response, artifact, file, author or request is a new unit.
allowed_authorities: Zenodo official record, versions and checksum-bound file APIs
GitHub official REST, Atom, raw-content and codeload endpoints
GitHub official artifact-attestation API for an exact SHA-256 subject
PyPI official project JSON and Integrity API for an exact distribution filename
Software Heritage official origin, visit, snapshot, release, revision and directory APIs
Crossref official work API and the exact JOSS review issue and comments
predeclared_evidence_order: 1. Verify the immutable V9 predecessor hashes and retain its adverse evidence without reinterpretation.
2. Query the exact Zenodo record, concept/version chain and frozen file checksum. Stop as CANNOT_CHECK if the publication version or frozen file identity is contradicted.
3. Query exact GitHub tag/ref, release, commit and repository-native metadata. A short prefix, branch head, release target_commitish string or deleted ref is insufficient.
4. Query exact PyPI Integrity and GitHub artifact-attestation subjects for indices 133 and 185. A 404 or unsigned artifact does not become negative provenance and cannot close a build edge.

5. Query Software Heritage origin visits and snapshots, then follow an exact tag branch only to a full revision and its directory. Deposit release-to-directory evidence alone is insufficient for a Git revision edge.

6. Compare checksum-bound archive content with an immutable provider-native revision only after the full revision is authenticated. Exact normalized path and byte equality may close the content identity gate. Subset or generated-projection equality does not.
7. Query the exact JOSS record only to corroborate publication DOI, repository, version and archive DOI. Editorial statements do not manufacture a missing full commit.
8. Apply the frozen conjunction and report every failed and not-reached gate. No score or compensatory rule is permitted.

closure_rule.edge: The exact publication DOI must bind the frozen archive version and repository. Accepted software rights must hold on the archive and immutable source. The archive must be bound to a full immutable source revision by an exact provider-native ref/release edge, an authenticated archival origin snapshot edge, or exact normalized archive-to-revision content equality.
closure_rule.build_projection: For a distribution projection, closure additionally requires provider-native provenance or attestation that binds the exact artifact SHA-256 to the full source commit. Local reproducibility, source-subset equality, matching version text, or a same-version tag is not sufficient.
closure_rule.cannot_check: Missing, ambiguous, mutable, name-only, third-party-only, unsigned or contradicted authority remains CANNOT_CHECK. Sequentially later gates are NOT_REACHED after a necessary failure.
closure_rule.scientific_boundary: An exact source edge is only source-frame progress. It grants no natural-pair eligibility, author-lineage independence, external custody, comparator outcome, performance or superiority authority.

targets.v10_discriminator: A corrected provider version record and archive root must bind exact version 0.0.3 to accepted commit 069ab4f56d100d765d46c594ac1b06add7e49f9e.
A corrected exact archive or authenticated provider statement must replace the adverse embedded Git authority that binds aa021231cdafb6d74ce9ab5f55f824a3032058a4.
Exact PyPI Integrity or GitHub artifact attestation must bind the sdist SHA-256 to accepted commit 7ac6d23d504404c4004faad663f6b889427109e6.
Exact PyPI Integrity or GitHub artifact attestation must bind the sdist SHA-256 to accepted commit dec5c58a3e3970bc6817f33efb615fea11057fce.

The Software Heritage source-origin snapshot may close only if an exact v0.13.4 branch points to full revision 0f8b2dbca06a3bb7031de9058ee9882995e04412 and that revision points to directory 178315b57afafc1f20ab9929b4de893430524c62 with accepted rights.

forbidden: treat a provider response, tag, commit, file, author or request as a new scientific unit
promote third-party discovery into provider-native authority
treat local reconstruction or subset equality as provider attestation
infer natural-pair eligibility, author-lineage independence, external custody or scientific performance from exact-edge closure
